title: Reset a LEFT/RIGHT Tipper Fault From the VISU_MANCONTROL Screen
summary: On the Operator Station HMI VISU_MANCONTROL screen, use the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button to clear the corresponding left or right tipper fault. Then verify the VISU_MANCONTROL informational banner/message area updates to reflect the reset (fault-related message cleared or replaced with a normal informational state).
when_to_use: Use when a LEFT or RIGHT tipper fault is indicated on the Operator Station HMI VISU_MANCONTROL screen and you need to reset the corresponding tipper fault using the screen’s manual control.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the VISU_MANCONTROL manual reset for the indicated LEFT/RIGHT tipper fault and verify the informational banner/message updates after the reset.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the VISU_MANCONTROL screen

access_required: tipper_hmi access to the VISU_MANCONTROL screen

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL (Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen) showing the informational banner (with right-side arrows) and the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET buttons.

steps.title: Open the VISU_MANCONTROL manual control screen
steps.purpose: Get to the Operator Station HMI screen that contains the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET buttons and the informational banner used to confirm the fault state.
steps.instruction: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed with the informational banner (alarms/informational messages) and the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET buttons visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The informational banner area is visible and the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET buttons are present on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL does not load or the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET buttons and informational banner are not visible.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_MANCONTROL
actions.exact_action: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen Item Description 1 An informational banner displaying alarms or informational messages... Item 6 The LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button will reset the corresponding tipper after a fault.

steps.title: Review the current banner message(s) for the active fault
steps.purpose: Confirm which LEFT/RIGHT tipper fault is currently indicated before pressing the corresponding reset button.
steps.instruction: Use the informational banner arrows on the right side of the banner to review the current alarm/informational messages so you can confirm what fault is present.
steps.expected_result: The informational banner message(s) corresponding to the current tipper fault are visible/identifiable via the banner navigation arrows.
steps.healthy_condition: Banner navigation arrows allow you to view the relevant current message(s) in the banner.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot navigate the banner messages (arrows do not change the displayed message) or the fault message cannot be identified.

actions.label: Navigate banner messages
actions.exact_action: Use the arrows on the right side of the banner to navigate through messages in the banner.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 1: An informational banner displaying alarms or informational messages. The arrows on the right side of the banner can be used to navigate through messages in the banner.

steps.title: Press the LEFT or RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button for the indicated side
steps.purpose: Clear the corresponding tipper fault using the manual reset control for the correct side.
steps.instruction: Select the correct side (LEFT or RIGHT) and press the corresponding LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button.
steps.expected_result: The corresponding tipper fault reset action is triggered for the selected side (LEFT or RIGHT).
steps.healthy_condition: You press the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button that matches the side indicated by the current banner message(s).
steps.failure_condition: The wrong side’s reset button is pressed (LEFT vs RIGHT mismatch) or the reset button cannot be pressed/does not respond.

actions.label: Reset indicated tipper fault
actions.exact_action: Select the correct side (LEFT or RIGHT) and press the corresponding LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 6: The LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button will reset the corresponding tipper after a fault.

steps.title: Verify the banner message updates after reset
steps.purpose: Confirm the reset cleared/updated the fault indication as reflected in the VISU_MANCONTROL informational banner.
steps.instruction: After pressing reset, re-check the informational banner messages (use the arrows again if needed) to confirm the fault-related message is cleared/updated.
steps.expected_result: The informational banner messages update to reflect that the corresponding LEFT or RIGHT tipper fault has been reset (fault-related message cleared or replaced with a new/normal informational state).
steps.healthy_condition: The banner no longer shows the same active fault message for the reset side; it is cleared or replaced with a normal informational state.
steps.failure_condition: The same fault message remains unchanged after the reset.

actions.label: Re-check banner messages
actions.exact_action: Re-check the informational banner messages (use the arrows again if needed) to confirm the fault-related message is cleared/updated.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the fault message does not change/clears within the expected operator observation window.
Do not proceed with additional manual actions if the banner continues to show an active fault condition.

success_criteria: After pressing the corresponding LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER FAULT RESET button, the VISU_MANCONTROL informational banner message for that fault is cleared or updated to a normal informational state.
healthy_conditions: VISU_MANCONTROL informational banner shows updated/cleared fault-related message after reset for the selected LEFT or RIGHT tipper.
failure_conditions: The same LEFT or RIGHT tipper fault message remains in the VISU_MANCONTROL informational banner after pressing the corresponding FAULT RESET button.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the same fault message remains after pressing the corresponding FAULT RESET button.
Do not proceed with additional manual actions if the banner continues to show an active fault condition.
